note: Delivery formats are file conditions, kept separate from media profiles (playback conditions). Dither (TPDF) is applied exactly once, whenever word length is reduced (including 32-bit float -> 24-bit), at the final export; only the float archive is undithered. See docs/SPEC.md section 5.3.

formats.use: distributor baseline (accepted by TuneCore; their recommendation is 24-bit/192 kHz WAV)
